title: RPG MAKER MZ Plugin: Action Bar Minigame

posts.author: Undermax
posts.body:
Hi to Everyone!
I’m excited to introduce my latest minigame plugin for RPG MAKER MZ:
Action Bar Minigame
This is perfect to celebrate the release of the new RPG MAKER MZ update (v1.9.0)
This exciting plugin injects a burst of adrenaline into your game by challenging players to hit the perfect moment.
Imagine a scene where every tap on the action bar brings dynamic visual feedback and critical in-game events.
Note:
For those who need even more advanced features, the
FULL version
is available as an upgrade,
extending the functionality of the demo version to meet more features and personalization.
The DEMO VERSION IS FREE.
